# Giovanni Nicolazzo — research portfolio

- Canonical English profile: https://colazeta.github.io/en/
- Italian profile: https://colazeta.github.io/it/
- German profile: https://colazeta.github.io/de/
- Research CV: https://colazeta.github.io/cv/
- Person: Giovanni Nicolazzo, PhD in Criminology (2025).
- Doctoral thesis: The Criminal Component of the Legal Economy: A Study of Patterns Based on Actors — https://publicatt.unicatt.it/handle/10807/302862
- Core research focus: criminal participation in the legal economy, hidden control, corporate opacity, ownership structures, sanctions and anti-money laundering.
- Current research:
  - research article in progress on the duty of active cooperation for anti-money-laundering purposes in public administrations
  - empirical study in progress on signals of criminal infiltration in the waste sector
  - working paper on real-estate vulnerability to money-laundering dynamics
- Methods: linked company data, ownership reconstruction, network analysis, proxy-based screening, case and documentary analysis, risk-indicator design.
- Selected public-interest projects:
  - systematic review on criminal infiltration in the legal economy — https://github.com/colazeta/criminal_infiltration_in_legal_economy_review
  - Lamezia Trasparente Monitor — https://github.com/colazeta/Lamezia-Trasparente-Monitor
- Public profiles:
  - https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=5zc-vxQAAAAJ
  - https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5551-2682
  - https://github.com/colazeta
  - https://www.linkedin.com/in/giovanni-nicolazzo
- Contact: giovanni.nicolazzo@unicatt.it
